name: Streaming Understanding Accountability In Blockchain Systems Bac338C047
text: Understanding accountability in blockchain systems presents the following source proposition: With the aim of increasing knowledge on accountability across three different types of blockchains (public, private and consortium), the researchers ask: how do blockchain systems construct accountability? This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Cryptographic hashing makes blockchain manipulation immediately detectable because the hash incorporates all previous transactions, so that even a single digit change produces a different hash value.
